release_read.basis: September quarter beat (rev $8.22B vs ~$8.13B, non-GAAP EPS $2.20 vs ~$2.18) and the December guide of $8.60B / $2.33 sits just above the $8.52B / $2.31 sell-side average but well below the >$9B buy-side whisper the thesis leaned on; China mix back up to 35% adds BIS risk, while a 27% dividend raise and $1.0B buyback plus a 24% washout into the print cushion it.

release.headline: Lam Research Corporation Reports Financial Results for the Quarter Ended September 27, 2026

vs_bar.consensus_source: https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/LRCX/analysis/ (snippet_only via stage E-P hunt); Morgan Stanley whisper >9.0 at https://www.tradingview.com/news/seekingalpha:93c889d67094b:0-morgan-stanley-expects-lam-research-to-guide-9b-plus-for-december-quarter/

key_line.detail: $8.60B +/- $0.4B: +5% q/q, at the sell-side average and ~4-5% below the >$9B buy-side whisper; China mix 35% of revenue (from 26% in June quarter).

guidance.detail: Guide in line with printed consensus ($8.60B vs $8.52B, EPS $2.33 vs $2.31), short of the whisper; no step-up of the kind July delivered (+14% vs consensus). Dividend raised to $0.33 from $0.26; ~$1.02B buyback in the quarter.

call.detail: Call held last night; I found no indexed coverage of its content in two searches, so whether the call (e.g. 2027 WFE, China, memory commentary) added to the drop is unknown.

public_reaction.summary: No indexed coverage of the October 2026 print, call or analyst actions surfaced in two searches before 09:20 ET; reaction read only from the tape.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 235.85 is -10.5% vs prev close 263.45 (tape labels prev_close_date 2026-10-20, so the 10-21 close may differ slightly), against a 6.6% implied move and my release read of +0.5%. After-hours was -8.3%, so the pre-market extended the drop overnight. Pre-market is alive (169 prints, 31 in the last 30 min, last 09:17), range 233.97-242.00. Market is soft too (SPY -0.9%, QQQ -0.7%). The gap to the release read suggests either the call said something the release does not, or the move overshoots a guide that met consensus but missed the whisper.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a December guide above the $8.52B average toward >$9B on customer capex; the guide came in at $8.60B, essentially at consensus, and China mix rose to 35%, so the counterparty step-up did not show up in Lam's own number.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market (not stale) and a whole night to read the print, so the open should hold nearly all of the -10.5%; a gap this far beyond the 6.6% implied move, on a guide that met consensus, tends to give some back in the first half hour, though an unread call and a weak tape cap that.

recommendation.reason: De koers staat voorbeurs ruim 10% lager, veel meer dan de opties verwachtten (6,6%) en meer dan de cijfers zelf rechtvaardigen: de omzetverwachting voor december ligt gewoon op de consensus, alleen onder de hoge hoop van beleggers. Zo'n grote daling na cijfers herstelt vaak een deel in het eerste halfuur, dus verkoop de positie om 10:00 in plaats van bij de opening. De verwachting is onzeker, omdat niet bekend is wat er gisteravond in het gesprek met analisten is gezegd.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als er voor 09:30 berichten verschijnen over een negatieve toon in het analistengesprek (bijvoorbeeld een zwakkere vooruitblik op 2027 of China) of de voorbeurskoers verder zakt onder 234, verkoop dan direct bij de opening.
